tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter chos lugs kyi las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg ji ltar bya thabs bzhugs so/ 104) tshad med thugs rje ye shes me chen gyis// las nyon bag chags stug po'i tshang tshing kun// srog rdzas bla ma yi dam lhar bcas la// btud nas sbyin sreg cho ga mdor bsdus bri//

'dir rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'i zab gter las byung ba'i chos bka' rnams kyi gzhung bzhin sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod na/ de yang gnas dang gang zag gi mtshan nyid sogs rgyud sde rnams las ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul ldan ni deng sang gi bskal dus kyi mi rnyed mod kyang*/ mdor bsdus na bla ma mchog la dam tshig ma nyams shing chos 'di dag gi dbang lung thob nas 105) bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len ci rigs bgyis pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi cho ga'i go rtogs dang ldan pa zhig gis gnas yid dag mthun par/ ji ltar dgos pa'i rdzas dang yo byad mtha' dag tshogs par byas la/ dus ni zhi rgyas dbang gsum la zla ba yar gyi ngo yi tshes grangs gza' skar 'phros sbyor bzang po dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg la ni mar ngo'i dus tshad drag cing rtsub la sde brgyad gyu thabs sogs mdor na shin tu rtsub pa'i dus dang sprad pa la sogs so so'i skabs thob shes par bya'o/ ༈ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ sngon 'gro rdzas dang yo byad bshams bkod ji ltar bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa gzhung bsrang ba dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams 106) zhar la ston pa dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dbang dang sgrub pa chen po sogs dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brail phyir sa'i cho ga sogs zur du mi dgos kyang*/ de lta bu dang ma 'brel na/ sa brtag sa bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba/ bsrung ba sogs tshul bzhin bya thabs rnams sbyin bsreg gi gzhung phal cher las 'byung pa bzhin 'dir yang grub na legs shing*/ de ltar mi nus na zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bstegs bu'am me thab kyi sa ni gtsang zhing bkra shis pa'i sa phyogs nas bslang ba dang*/ drag po'i skabs su ni dur khrod kyi sa la bya bar gsungs/ de yangagazhung rnams nas bshad pa ltar gyi thab khung sogs ni mi 'grub tshe/

sri thab bya ba'i tshul ni/ stegs bu zheng du mda' gang dngadapangs su sor bzhi pa bya ste/ dbyibs ni drag po la gru gsum dang gzhan rnams la gru bzhir bya ba'am/ yang zlum po gru bzhi zla gam sogs phrin las bzhi tha dad dang mthun par bzos legs la/ cis kyang long med pa'am ma 'byor na lcags glang sas bkang pas kyang rung ste/ de'i steng du dkyil 'khor ni zhi rgyas dbang gsum la pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud can 107) dang drag por ni 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ so so'i lte ba dang mtha' skor du/ zhi ba la rdo rje/ rgyas pa la nor bu 'bar ba/ dbang la pad+ma lcags kyu/ drag po la rgya gram dang ral gris mtshan pa/ phyi rol du rdo ra dang me ris bskor ba 'bri zhing*/ rdul mtshan gyi kha dog kyang dkar zhi ba/ ser rgyas pa/ dmar dbang*/ mthing drag po/ rnams las dang mthun par shas che bya/ gal te rdul tshon ma grub na shog bu sogs la bris shing tshon kha bsgyur te 'ding na'ang rung la/ de tsam yang mi nus na ni 'bru tshom tso la brten pa las 'os ma mchis pa nyid do/ de'i steng du bud shing gi ni gzhung chen po rnams las bye brag mang du gsungs kyang*/ bsdu na zhi ba la glang ma'am lcang ma zlum po sbom phra 'dzub mo dang mnyam pa/ rgyas pa la star kha sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing la gru bzhi gung mo dang mnyam pa/ dbang la mdog dmar zhing ro skyur ba'i rigs se rgod sogs phyed gshag zla gam srin lag dang mnyam pa/ drag por skyer sa tsher nag sogs la bzhi gshag zur gsum 108) mthe'u chung dang mnyam pa bya ste/ ring thung rtsigs tshul dang ring thung gi tshad la sogs pa thams cad gtso bor slob dpon gyi phyag bzhes mthong ba rgyud pa gal che la/ gal te cis kyang shing rnams med pa'i sa phyogs su ni lce ring thung gi tshad ni zhi ba la khru gang*/ rkang gang*/ mtho gang*/ chag gang sa dang bzhi dgos la/ rgyas pa la khru gang sa sha stag

dbang la khru rkang mtho dang gsum/ drag por zhi ba dang tshad mthun pa nyid do/ ba la'ang rung bar bshad cing*/ de dag gang yin zlum po gru bzhi zla gam gru gsum las so so dang mthun par rtsigs pa'i khar ku sha gtsang mas khyab par rtse mo las gang byed ci phyogs dang mthun par bkab/ de yang kha lta phyogs ni dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na de nyid kyi phyogs bzhi tha dad dang bstun dgos la/ dkyil 'khor dang mi 'brel na phyi rol gyi shar zhi lho drag nub dbang byang rgyas dang mthun par byas pa'i phyogs su grub pa so kha bltas te me thabs dang kha sprod du bya ba'o/ slob dpon gyi g.yas phyogs su stegs kyi steng du me tog tshom bu'i khar (rgyas par dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi lha grangs dang mnyam pa dgos mod kyi bsdu na rigs lngar ma 'dus pa med phyir tshom bu lnga dgod de/) rnam rgyal gyi bum pa dang*/ las bum dang bcas pa kha rgyan mgul 'chings bum rdzas sogs spyi mthun dang*/ 109) las bum ma 'dzom na dung chos sam/ mthar ni 'gu rtse sogs kyi kyang rung bar ku sha'i chun bu dang bcas te bsangs bcu'i snod du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bsgom bzlas byas pa'i chu dang*/ gzhan yang las bzhi gar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs chos skyong dang bcas gtor ma ji ltar 'byor pa sman dang rak+ta/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ drag po la ni zor du 'phangs rgyu'i gtor ma sha khrag tsha nyung dang tsangs sogs kyis brgyan pa gtso cher bshams/ khyad par gyi 'bul gtor ni/ zhi ba la dkar gsum gang 'byor gyi brdzis pa'i gtor ma zlum po nyer gcig sogs ci 'byor dang*/ rgyas pa la dkar gsum mngar khu sogs kyi brdzis te zur bzhi pa dang*/ dbang la chang dang 'bri mog sogs kyis brdzis pa zla gam gyi dbyibs can/ drag por 'bru nag gi phye la dug khrag ro sol sogs kyi brdzis shing byug pa'i nag po zur gsum gyi dbyibs can dang*/

de dag gi gtor rgyan yang dkar zhi ser rgyas dmar dbang mthing drag tha dad kyi brgyan pa grangs can du byas pa bshams/ 110) phyi mchod ni/ las bzhi so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i me tog dang*/ de bzhin du spos dang dra chab kyang 'byor na zhi ba la tsan dan dmar po/ si hu/ spos dkar/ ga bur/ a ga ru dkar po sogs dang*/ rgyas pa la ar ser dang*/ 'gi wam/ na khi/ spri yang khu/ dza ti gur khum sogs sbyar ba dang*/ dbang la tsan dan dmar po/ ar smug rde dreg spang spos/ kha gul/ sin+du ra sogs sbyar ba dang*/ drag po la sha chen/ gla rtsi/ mi zi/ shing thun/ sgog pa/ chu dag nag po la sogs kyis dri chab dang spos bya bar bshad/ mar me yang zhi ba la mar dkar mar khu/ rgyas pa la shing tog gi mar khu sogs dang*/ dbang la mar khu de dag 'bri mog dang sbyar ba'am/ spra tsil gyi mar khu/ drag po la zhun chen dang til nag yung dkar gyi mar khu sogs bya bar gsungs/ zhal zas kyang zhi ba la 'bras kyi dkar gsum las bzos pa'i kha dog dkar po dang*/ rgyas pa la 'bru sna'i phye la mar khu dang bsres pa ser po dang*/ dbang la ram bu'i phye'am gro ma'i phye 111) la mngar gsum dang sbyar ba dmar po/ drag por bra zan gyi phye la dug khrag ro sol dang sbyar bas nag por bya bar gsungs la/ yang me tog dngos ma 'dzoms pa'i dus na mchod 'bru kha dog las bzhi (tshon gyis bsgyur ba'am rang grub ) so so dang mthun par bya ba dang*/ yon chab kyi rigs rnams kyang*/ (zhi bar 'o ma/ rgyas par gur gum/ dbang la gya skeg drag por snag tsha'am ro sogs kyis ) kha dog tha dad par bsgyur nas bshams dgos par gsungs so/ gzhan yang mchod gtor bshams pa'i gdan/ sgrub pa/ so rnams kyi zhwa gos rgyan chas gdan (tshon gyis bsgyur ba'am rang grub ) khrir bcas pa mtha' dag phrin las bzhi tha dad kyi mdog dang bstun zhing*/ khrus dang byug rdzas/ 'dug stangs/ phyag rgya/ skor phyogs/

dgang*/ mugs 'dzin tshul sogs tha dad pa'i dgos tshul zhib cha rnams sbyin sreg gi rgyud dang gzhung chen thams cad nas gsungs bas 'byor na de ltar bya la/ gal te sgrub pa po dang sbyin bdag sogs kyi 112) skabs las ji lta bar ma 'dzoms na gang 'dzom gyis kyang rung ste/ gtso bor mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin kho na gal che ba ste/ bzang ngan gyi byed las mtha' dag sems kyi bsgyur kha la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ de ltar phyi mchod bshad nas/ nang mchod gsang mchod khyad par gyi mchod rdzas sogs gzhung gzhan nas mang du gsungs na'ang*/ chos bka' 'di dag gi gzhung las mang gsungs phyir dngos su bshams mi dgos la/ 'di skabs kyi drag po'i sreg rdzas khyad par ni/ dgra gegs kyi liṅga dug shing gi lo ma la (bri tshul dang sngags la sogs zhib par 'dod na dgongs 'dus sbyin sreg ltar ) bris pa grangs mang nyung skabs dang bstun pas gang mtshams dang*/ zan ling che ba zhig dang bcas pa snga tshags su tshud par bya/ gzhan yang*/ 'brog dbrang zhes bya ba/ sha khrag tshil rkang zhag rus pa dang bcas pa rnams dgra gegs kyi sha khrag sogs su mos la snod du gcig tu bshams pa dang*/ thun rdzas zhes pa ni lcags phye zangs phye/ 13) gri lcags kyi dri gzar gyi rbab rdo' rdo phye dang*/ snye rtse shangs rtse thang 'brom 'bru dgu sbang snyams kyi phye sogs lhan cig dug khrag gis sbol la snod gcig tu bshams pa ste/ 'di ltar liṅga dang 'brog brang thun rdzas rnams ni drag po kho na la ma gtogs zhi rgyas dbang gsum la mi dgos so/ de ltar mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad dang bcas pa rnams slob dpon gyi g.yas/ me thab kyi g.yon (drag por go logs tu bshams ) du bshams/ slob dpon gyi g.yon me thab kyi g.yas su sreg rdzas rnams bshams te/ de yang las bzhi spyi khyab thams cad la dgos pa'i sreg rdzas ni/ mar khu/ yams shing*/ til/ tsa durba/

'bras/ zas mchog ku sha so ba nas sran ma dang bcas pa rnams tha dad du bshams par bya ste/ de las dang por mar khu ni zhi rgyas gnyis las mar dkar bzhus pa dang*/ dbang drag gnyis la til dmar gyis rung ngo*/ yams shing ni zhi ba la bal dkar sor bzhi pa shun pa dang bcas pa la dkar gsum gyis byug pa dang*/ 114) rgyas pa la star kha kham bu sogs 'bras bu can sor bcu gnyis pa lo 'dab cung zad dang ldan zhing zhun mar dang chang gis byug pa dang*/ dbang la seng ldeng mdzod mo shing sogs mang du bshad kyang rgya shugs kyi rung la ste sor brgyad pa mtshal lam btsags dang sin+dhu ra dang mngar gsum gyis byug pa dang*/ drag por tsher nag sogs la sor bcu gnyis pa zur gsum rno bar gzhogs te mi rta khyi sogs kyi khrag dang ro sol dang tshwa chus byugs pa ste/ de ltar yam shing thams cad brgya'am nyer gcig la sogs ci 'byor bshams/ zas mchog ces pa ni/ zhi ba'i skabs su 'bras chan btsos pa la zho dang 'o ma btab pa dang*/ rgyas par ni 'bras chan de la mar khu sbrang rtsi sogs btab cing gzhan yang zas sna bzang po gang 'dzoms dang shing tog sogs snod gcig tu blug pa yin la/ dbang la ni 'bras dmar ram gro'i chan la chang dang mngar gsum gang 'byor btab pa dang*/ drag po la ni nas sran nag sogs kyi chan la khrag dang lan tsha btab pa ste/ de ltar zas 115) mchog 'di nyid la sbyin sreg gzhan du ni zan zhes kyang grags pa'o/ durba dang ku sha rnams la yang zhi rgyas dbang gsum la ni legs par bkrus nas mar dkar bzhus pa'i khu bas bran zhing 'o 'dab dang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa bya la/ rtag sor gyi dug khrag gi bran zhing dum bur btub par bshad do/ khyad par du drag po la til gyi tshab tu thang khrom rigs gsum gang rnyed kyi 'bru la bya bar bshad pa dang*/ de bzhin du mar khu yang bse shing mar khu dang*/ ran rog gi mar khu sogs la bya bar gzhung chen rnams las 'byung kyang mi rnyed pas til mar nyid kyi chog go

de lta bu'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams kyi snod kyang phrin las bzhi so so dang bstun te/ zhi ba la dung dang nya phyis dngul dang dkar yol la sogs dang*/ rgyas pa la gser dang ra gan dbang la zangs sam rdza dmar/ drag por lcags dang so dang thod pa sogs su bshams par gsungs pa bzhin 'dzom na'ang legs shing*/ mdor na don dam par 'khor 'das 116) kyi chos thams cad mnyam nyid rig pa'i klong du ma gyur pa rdul tsam med pa/ de la ni mtshan ma'i spros pa thams cad las 'das kyang*/ gnyis 'dzin ma zad kyi bar du kun lardzob rten cing 'brel 'byung gi cha nas rgyu dang 'bras bu bslu med du 'byung ba'i tshul la khyad du mi gsad par nges shes 'drongs dgos phyir/ spros med don ji ltar rtogs bzhin du spros pa'i tshul gyi lag len rnams la rtsings chos su mi bya bar rgyal ba'i bka' gzhung dag dang mthun par bya dgos kyi/ spros med kha khyer tsam gyi gdengs 'khur nas zog chos gzu lum ras chod du 'gyur ba'i nyen yod pas/ des na 'di dag gi lag len zhib rgyas mtha' dag bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sbyin sreg me 'od 'bar ba/ zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi sbyin sreg 'phrin las rang grol sogs dang*/ gsang sngags gsar ma ltar na slob dpon a bha ya'i sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma sogs kyi dgongs pa lon/ dgos pa yang phyi rabs kyi gang zag 117) shes ldan rnams kyi dgongs 'tshal/ de ltar dkyil 'khor yo byad bshams dgos thams cad legs par grub cing*/ gzhan yang dgang blugs rdor dril rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad mtha' dag legs par 'dzoms nas/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i las rim ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ thog mar bdagabaskyed yi dam gang dang yang rung ba'i las gzhung bsrang ba'am/ khyad par gter kha 'di'i lugs kyi rgyas par spro na/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi tshe bdag mdun thams cad thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi gzhung ltar dang*/

rgyas pa la tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i las gzhung bsrang ba dang*/ dbang la rta phag yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ drag po'i skabs su dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i chog gzhung ltar bya ba skabs su bab mod kyang*/ re zhig skabs 'dir gang zag rnams 'jug bde ba'i slad du gzhi thams cad la bdag dang bum pa gnyis kar rgyal ba dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar kho 118) na bskyed pa'i tshul 'chad par bya ste/ hrīḥ bdag nyid 'gyur med ye nas rdo rje'i sku// zhes sogs nas bzung ste bstod pa'i bar du las byang gzhung bzhin las/ khyad par lha bskyed pa'i skabs su rnam rgyal bum pa de yang phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang ye shes lnga'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad zla'i gdan la pad+ma 'od 'bar bdag bskyed dang mtshungs par gsal zhing sku mdog dmar la cung zad las dang mthun pa'i kha bsgyur te/ de yang gzhung tshig gi 'gyur med sku mdog gangs la nyi shar 'dra// dmar mdangs cung zad 'tsher la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa 'di nyid/ dbang gi sbyinal sreg la 'di ka sor bzhag bya zhing*/ gzhan zhi ba'i skabs su yin na/ dkaralamadangs cung zad 'tsher la// zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du rgyas pa/ ser mdangs dang*/ drag po la mthing mdangs zhes kha bsgyur shes pa bya zhing*/ dmigs pa yang de dang mthun pa'i sku mdog tu bdag bskyed 119) bum bskyed gnyis kar gsal ba dang*/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe rnga yab gling nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dpag med byon nas bdag bum gnyis kar thim pa'i mos pa bya/ 'dzab kyi skabs su bdag bum gnyis kar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la pad+ma 'od 'bar dkar po'i spyi bor om̐ dkar gyi mtha' skor du/

om̐ ā hūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ om̐ shān+ting ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes sngags phreng dkar pos bskor bar dmigs nas brgya stong sogs skabs dang sbyar la bzla zhing bdag bum gnyis ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang gzhan kun gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar bsam/ ༈ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg la/ bdag bum gnyis ka pad+ma 'od 'bar sku mdog ser po'i lte bar bh+ruṃ ser gyi mthar/ badz+ra gu ru'i sham bur bh+ruṃ puṣ+ṭing ku ru ye swā hāḥ zhes ser pos bskor ba las 'od zer ser po dpag med 'phros pas/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas pas bsam la 120) sngags bzla/ ༈ dbang la sku mdog dmar po'i mgrin par hrī dmar gyi mthar badz+ra gu ru dang*/ hrīḥwa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā zhes dmar pos bskor zhing 'od zer dmar pos khams gsum dbang du sdud par bsam/ ༈ drag po la sku mdog mthing ga'i gsang gnas su mthing la badz+ra gu ru dang*/ sarba du ṣ+ṭan ma ra ya phaṭaḥ ces mthing gas bskor ba'i 'od zer me'i tsha tsha 'phro chung mtshon cha'i char sogs grangs med 'phros pas gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad par dmigs la bzla ste/ 'di dag ni yang zab nyid kyi phrin las bzhi sgrub kyi dgongs pa yin zhing*/ de nyid nas gsungs pa'i 'dod gsol gyi tshigs bcad rnams so so'i thun mthar brjod kyang legs so/ ༈ las bum mam bsangs chu'i snod der skyed chog ni/ om̐ swā bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswā bha wa shu d+dhonyahaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis// phyi ni bum gzugs nang gzhal yas// dbus su pad nyi'i gdan steng du// 121) hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rgyal kun mchod// 'gro ba'i don byas 'od tshur bsdus// yongs gyur khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil// ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas// rdo rje'i dbyug to nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pa thugs kar sdig mdzub bsgrengs// khro bo'i chas brgyan dor stabs 'gyings// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs thim// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ ljang las// 'od 'phros rig lnga spyan drangs pas// bum pas dbang bskur bdud rtsi'i rgyun// phab pas sku gang dri ma dag don grub rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyur// badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta pū dza pra tits+tsha āḥhūm̐/ ༈ 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can// 122) khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod// las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas bstod/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sngags 'phreng ljang sngon gyi bskor bar dmigs la/ om̐ āḥbi ghā nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ sngags rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas snod khengs/ mthar lha nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas chu la thim pas/ bdud rtsi'i chu de gang dang gang la 'khor ba tsam gyis 'bags rtsogs nyes skyon mtha' dag zhi zhing*/ phrin las gang 'dod 'grub pa'i mthu ldan du gyur par bsam mo/ ༈ de nas skabs 'dir las byang gi tshogs byin rlabs bya zhing spel nas phud dkyil 'khor la 'bul drag po yin na liṅga bsgral las rgyas bsdus gang 'os kyang 'dir bya'o/ ༈ de nas bsangs chu de nyid sreg rdzas thams cad la ku sha'i chun bus 'thor zhing*/ om̐ swā bha wa shud+dhaḥsogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyangs la/ om̐ āḥswā hā/ sngags 'di rnams rdo gdan bzhi sogs rgyud sde mang po las gsungs pa'i sreg rdzas sbyang ba'i 123) sngags te/ gsar rnying thams cad dgongs pa mthun no/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ dziṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhū/ sreg rdzas kyi snod rnam par dag pa stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ bcud rnam par dag pa ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa so so gang la gang 'dod kyi longs spyod zad mi shes shing phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur/

de nas me thab la me sbar ba ni/ gzhung chen rnams las gsungs pa ltar gyi me blang ba'i yul dang*/ sbar mkhan/ spar ba'i rdzas dang yo byad sogs phrin las tha dad la gsungs pa rnams tshul bzhin 'dzoms na legs shing*/ ma 'byor na mos pa tsam la brten pa dang*/ las bzhi so so'i phyogs su kha bltas nas me sbar zhing*/ bsangs chu ni zhi rgyas dbang gsum la g.yas bskor dang*/ drag por g.yon skor gyi 'thor nas/ thog mar bgegs sbyangs zhing bsrung ba ni/ om̐ swā bhā wa = 'khor 'das kyi 124) dngos po'i mtshan 'dzin thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las me thab kyi dbus su hūm̐ yig 'dod 'od dang gzi mdangs 'bar ba ri rab tsam zhig gsal ba las 'od zer me'i tsha tsha khro chung mtshon tsha la sogs skar ltar 'khrug pa 'phros pas/ sbyin bsreg gi las bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rigs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu yig 'bru phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i ra ba me dpung dang bcas pas bsrung ba'i gur khang chen por gyur/ hūm̐/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klongs dkyil nas// me lha drang srong yi dam gtogs pa'i// gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs rnams phyir gdegs shig mi 'gro gnas 'dir 'dug na rdul du rlog om̐ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥdang*/ hūm̐/ dug lnga 125) 'joms pa'i ye shes me 'od lnga*// yig 'bru lnga dang de bzhin phyag mtshan lnga*// khro tshogs sprul pa dpag yas bsam mi khyab// srung 'khor rim pa lnga yi tshul du bskor// 'bar ba ye shes me yis mtshams chod cig om̐ an ga ye dz+wa la raṃ/ dhi ni raṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ tsag raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ shar lho nub byang phyogs phyogs nas// me sbar lha mo rang mdog ldan// dri za gshin rje gnod sbyin klu// zhi rgyas dbang drag me sbar mdzod// hūm̐ hrīḥ

mtshams bzhi me lha srin po dang*// rlung lha dbang ldan la sogs kyang*// shing thun rnams kyis shing thus shig rlung g.yab rnams kyi rlung g.yob cig zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las mdzod// om̐ ag+ni dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐/ de nas me lha dam tshig pa bskyed cing ye shes pa bstim nas phyag 'tshal mchod bstod bya pa la/ thog ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg lugs ltar na/ hūm̐/ me thab mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las// e las byung ba zhi ba'i thab khung zlum// dkar gsal mdangs ldan me lce zlum por 'bar// dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du// dam tshig me lha drang srong cha lugs can// sku mdog dkar po 'dzum zhing zhi 'dzum mdzes// zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ra skyes chibs// phyag g.yas me thab 'og mas ghu rde bsnams// g.yon pa bgrang phreng 'og mas lcags kyu 'dzin/ /sha rgyas gzugs byung sgeg cing lto ba 'phyang*// smra ra dmar ser ral pa'i cod paṇa can// drang srong tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbus na gsal// bdag nyid yi dam lha yi thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros shar lho me lha'i yul nas ni// ye shes sems dpa'i dam tshig ji lta bar// drang srong tshogs kyi 127) bskor ba spyan drangs gyur// 'di bzhin du/ rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg la tshig gzhan rnams gong bzhin las/ e las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung ni// gru bzhi ser po me lce rin chen 'bar// de dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs su// dam tshig me lha seng ge gzi brjid can// zhes kha bsgyur zhing*/ de bzhin du dbang gi skabs su/ e las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung dmar// zla gam me lce 'gugs byed lcags kyu 'bar// zhes pa dang*/ dam tshig me lha dmar po chags pa'i mdangs// zhes sogs dang*/ drag po la/ e las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung ni// gru gsum ljang nag me lce mtshon char 'bar// zhes dang*/ dam tshig me lha ljang nag khros pa'i sku/

zhes pas kha bsgyur bar bya'o/ de nas phrin las bzhi ga'i me lha spyan 'dren ni/ las so so'o kha dog mthun pa'i mda' dar g.yab/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// spyan 'dren tshur gshegs 'byung 128) po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog rang bzhin gnas nas sku bskyod la// rang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du// rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po nas// gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir// spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// om̐ ag+na ye/ bhi ri ṣi ny+ya dzaḥdzaḥ e h+ya hi/ sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ gzi brjid 'bar ba me yi lha// yid la 'dod pa kun bsgrub cing*// thugs rjes sems can don byed pa// 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol// om̐ ag+na de wa/ sa ma ya/ a we sha ya tiṣ+tha lhan/ dam ye gnyis med du gyur pa la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// zhi la sogs pa'i lha dpal te// ji ltar 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa// gzi brjid rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan 129) dag na// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo ji snyed kun// ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// phrin las sgrub phyir bzhes su gsol// o g+na de wa t+ya/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai bi d+ya/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// 'dod yon bla med mchod pa 'di// ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol// om̐ ag+ne de wa t+ya/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ ghan+dha/ rā sa/ par+she pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ stong gsum 'di = bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad stong sbyar dang*// rak+ta dmar mchod ar+ghaṃ dang*// bcud ldan mchog gi gtor ma rnams// ye shes me lha'i =phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes

130) su gsol// om̐ ag+na de wa t+ya/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ rak+ta/ bha ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐/ stong gsum = 'dod yon mchog gi longs spyod ni// tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// ye shes me lha = phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol// om̐ ag+na de wa t+ya ga na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ de ltar de yan gyi mchod pa rnams ni las bzhi thams cad la 'bul zhing*/ drag po yin na/ 'brog 'brang 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ nga bdag gzung 'dzin dgra gegs sha khrag rus// klad pa rkang mar tshil bu nang rol bcas// gzugs kyi phung po me lha'i zhal du 'bul// ma rung gdug pa thul phyir bzhes su gsol// o ag+na de wa t+ya/ sarba sha truṃ a mu kaṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dang ces 'bul zhing*/ mnga' gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ che ba'i che mchog me lha ni// khams gsum bsreg 131) phyir zhal cher bgrad// srid gsum gzigs phyir spyan gsum hrig /stong gsum 'dul phyir me dpung 'bar// 'ur 'ur chem chem sreg byed sku// las ngan sdig sgrib zhal du bsreg / bsam sbyor ngan pa zhal du bsreg rbad 'dre rbad gtong zhal du bsreg rkyen ngan bar chad zhal du bsreg om̐ ag+ni de wa t+ya gnod byed 'byung po sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ dang de nas thun rdzas phul la/ hūm̐/ lcags phye zangs phye rdo phye sogs// khrag dang bsres te 'bul lags na// mun+dha ra yi chang dang sbyar// bsres pas dgra gegs phung bar mdzod// a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭaḥdang*/ de ltar gong gi 'brog 'brang nas 'di yan chad rnams drag po ma gtogs gzhan gsum la mi dgos shing*/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la ni tshogs phul ba'i 'jug der so so'i 132) yam shing 'di ltar 'bul te/ zhi ba'i yam shing glang ba bal dkar sogs// zhi ba'i rdzas kyi bran nas byin rlabs pa// bcom ldan ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub phyir bzhes su gsol// om̐ ag+ne de wa t+ya/

nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes 'bul zhing de bzhin du rgyas pa la/ rgyas pa'i yam shing 'bras bu can rnams la// de dang mthun pa'i rdzas byug byin rlabs te// bcom ldan ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// rgyas pa'i phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol// o ag+ne de wa t+ya/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad puṣ+ṭing ku ru ye swā hā/ dbang la/ hūm̐/ dbang gi yam shing tsan dan rgya shug la/ /de dang mthun pa'i rdzas byug byin rlabs nas// bcom ldan ye shes = dbang gi phrin las = om̐ ag+ni de 133) wa t+ya/ khams gsum srid pa gsum gyi skye 'gro dang brtan g.yo'i bcud dang nus mthu thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ drag po la/ hūm̐/ drag po'i yam shing tsher ma dug shing tshogs// de dang mthun pa'i rdzas byug byin rlabs pa// bcom ldan ye shes me lha'i = drag po'i phrin las = om̐ ag+ni de wa t+ya/ gnod byaid dgra gegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas sreg gzhan rnams kyang rim pa bzhin (bsreg rdzas thams cad kyi phud cung zad re bcad nas 'og tu yi dam la 'bul ba yang phyag bzhes te/ btso bor mthong ba brgyud pa gal che'o/) 'bul ba ni/ thog mar dgang blugs kyi sbyor bas mar khu lan gsum sogs ci rigs 'bul zhing*/ om̐ ag+na ye/ a dhi bh+yaḥ sadhi bh+ya/ ā bhe sha ya ma hā shri ye/ ha bya ka bya/ bha ha nā ye swā hā/ zhes pas 'bul zhing*/ gong gi yams shing gi sngags mtha' dang mthun par/ 'dir/ las 134) bzhi gang yin pa'i dgos gsol brjod/ 'di bzhin bsreg rdzas 'og ma kun la yang sngags ring brjod pa'i mthar so so'i sngags gdags par bya ste/ om̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pas til 'bul zhing dgos gsol sngar ltar bya/ om̐ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes nas durba 'bul/ o badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras 'bul/

om̐ badz+ra paṃ pa te swā hā/ zas mchog 'bul/ om̐ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ ku sha 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ so ba 'bul/ om̐ ma hā bi t+yā swā hā/ nas 'bul/ om̐ ma hā ba la swā hā/ sran ma 'bul te/ de ltar sreg rdzas phul ba'i mthar// hūm̐/ gzi brjid 'bar ba me yi lha// drang srong chen po'i lha tshogs rnams// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad phyir// sbyin sreg mchod pa bzhes su gsol// hūm̐/ ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du// 135) dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg 'di// me lha drang srong khyod la mchod pa 'bul// phrin las rnam bzhi myur du 'grub par mdzod// ha ha he he hūm̐ hūm̐/ de nas bstod pa ni/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad phyag bzhi pa// las kun sgrub mdzad 'od po che// sngon tshe dus na lha yi mched// da lta rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i mched// las kun mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ drang srong me lha gzi brjid 'bar ba'i 'od// 'gro don thugs rje rgyun chad med pa yi// yab yum sras dang sprul 'khor bcas pa la// dam rdzas sbyin bsreg mchod pa 'di phul bas// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thams cad ni// thogs med myur du bsgrub pa'i dus la babs// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ karma ku ru hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ las bzhi so so'i 'dod gsol 136) ni/ zhi ba la/ ho/ drang srong chen po khyod la phrin las su gsol ba ni/ bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas pa rnams la/ sdang ba'i dgra gnod pa'i bgegs/ gdugs pa'i dbal/ rno ba'i mtshon/ sbyor ba'i dug nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu/ ye 'brog sum rgya drug cu/ rmi las ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ sbyor ba rtsub pa/ lo skag zla kag zhag kag za kag mo ngan rtsis rtsub/ mi kha bram chu la sogs pa/ mdor na bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

shan+ting ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes sogs gang 'dod skabs dang sbyar ro/ de bzhin du rgyas pa/ ho/ drang srong chen po khyod la phrin las gsol ba ni// bdag sogs dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor 137) pa snyan pa dang grags pa stobs dang nus pa gzi brjid dang longs spyod bu nor dang mnga' thang ting 'dzin dang nyams rtogs sogs dge legs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shan+ting ku ru ye swā hā/ dbang la/ ho/ drang srang chen po =

bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la khams gsum srid gsum 'jig rten kun gyi mi nor zas gsum mos pa rnam bzhi lha 'dre mi gsum gyi mthu stobs longs spyod la sogs snang srid 'khor 'das kyi 'dod dgu'i dngos grub thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ drag po la/ hoḥ drang srong chen po khyod la phrin las su gsol ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ dge 'du gyi spyi dgra byed pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i dgos dgra gyur pa la sogs 138) dang khyad par bdag sogs dpon slob yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ bsam pa ngan zhing sbyor ba rtsub mo bshom par byed pa'i dgra bo byas ma lha bsrung dag bcas pa gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs rgyab rten dpung rogs dang bcas pa la sogs log par 'dren zhing 'tshe bar gyur pa'i ru dra thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzad du gsol/ med par mdzad du gsol/ stong par mdzad du gsol/ ming gi lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par mdzad du gsol/ sarba shatruṃ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ de nas bar skabs 'dir/ tshe lha'i lto bar gzhal yas khang gsal bar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gang 'dod bskyed pa la sbyin bsreg gi mchod pa 'bul bar gsungs pas 'dir yang tshe sgrub dang thugs rje chen po la sogs gang bskyed kyang rung mod kyi/ 'on kyang lha thams cad rgyal ba zhi khro la ma 'dus pa gang yang med phyir/ zhi khro 139) nges don snying po ltar bskyed par bya ste/ me thab du dug shing cung zad kha gsos nas bsangs chu 'thor te/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong chen po'i sku'i rab tu yangs pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus su/ ye shes 'od lnga 'khrig pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i bdag nyid rgyal ba pad+ma 'od 'bar sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs pa'i thugs chos dbyings khyab gdal gyi klong na/

rang sems ka dag gi ngo bo kun bzang yab yum/ lhun grub ye shes kyi rang mdangs rigs lnga yab yum bcu/ sems dpa' sems dma' thub drug sgo ba sgo ma dang bcas pa rnams kyi rtsal gdangs 'gag med kyi rol par/ klad pa dung khang 'bar ba'i pho brang 'ja' 'od me spungs thig le'i klong du/ khro bo thams cad kyi spyi dpal che mchog he ru ka yab yum gyi 'khor du/ sprul pa'i khrag 'thung yab yum bcu dang*/ yang sprul kau ri ma mo brgyad/ singha phra men brgyad/ las byed sgo ma bzhi/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs dang*/ mgrin par rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum bcu/ lte bar yum mchog mkha' 'gro sde lnga la ma mo mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor ba/ gsang bar dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bskor ba dang*/ gzhan yang sku'i ba spu'i khung bu yan chad la phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon dang gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pas/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar byon nas dam tshig gi 141) lha tshogs rnams la thim par 'gyur/ zhes tshig don mthun par bskyed la/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod kyi rim pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// rang mdangs rig pa'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du so so'i sku sprul pa// yab yum sras dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ rang byung lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas khang*// ye nas ma bcos rang babs dkyil 'khor 'dir// glang chen la sogs baṃ dang nyi zla'i steng*// sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugasasu gsol// sa ma ya a be sha ya tiṣ+tha lhan/ hūm̐/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las ste// snang stong grags stong gsal stong rig stong dang*// bde stong dbyer med a 'thas sdug bsngal bral// rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu ho pra ti dza ho/

ya ni na mo/ hūm̐ hrīḥ mchod yon brgya dang rgyal srid rin chen 142) bdun// 'dod yon lnga ldan phyi mchod sna tshogs 'bul// lha mo bcu drug sman raka bdud rtsi dang*/ dug lnga ye shes sbyor grol nang mchod 'bul// om̐ āḥhūm̐/ sarba pū dza ho/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dga' bzhi bde stong gsal// phyi nang snod bcud 'dod yon phyi gtor dang*// dug lnga phung po sha khrag nang gtor dang*// ye shes lnga ldan ting 'dzin gsang gtor 'bul// om̐ ā hūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ par+she pra tits+tsha āḥhūm̐/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ de nas bar 'dir dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ dgang blug gi sbyor bas mar khu lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs 'bul ba ni/ sngags ni/ om̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni 143) na mas+sa man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ ag+ni ye swā hā/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la sbyin bsreg gi mchod pa phul nas/ bdag sogs yon mchod thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan bar chad shan+ting ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs phrin las bzhi gang yin gyi 'dod gsol rnams gong du yam shing gi skabs bshad pa ltar brjod/ de bzhin du/ yam shing*/til/ durba/ zas mchog ku sha/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma rnams kyang gong ltar 'bul zhing*/ lngags ni yam shing la/ om̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ badz+ra ti pa lā ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ gzhan rnams la rim pa bzhin/ om̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes sogs gong ma rnams ltar 'gres nas shes par bya zhing*/ sran ma'i rjes la bdud rtsi/ rak+ta/ gtor ma/ tshogs dang bcas pa yang rang rang gi sngags (om̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ) kyi 'bul/ zhes pa dang*/

de bzhin du/ 144) ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta*/ ga na tsakra sogs/ drag po la/ 'brog 'brang*/ liṅga*/ thun rdzas rnams kyang 'bul zhing*/ de thams cad la/ bcom ldan ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul zhes pa'i sar/ bcom ldan dkyil 'khor lha'i tshogs la 'bul/ zhes dang*/ sngags kyi skabs su yang*/ ag+ni de wa t+ya zhes pa'i sar gu ru de wa ḍa ki ni zhes bsgyur shes par bya'o/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun bzang yab yum thugs rje'i sprul pa ni// rdor sems spyan ma la sogs rigs lnga dang*/ sems dpal sems dma' yab yum bcu drug bcas// thub drug sgo ba yab yum brgyad la sogs// zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod// che mchog la sogs khrag 'thung yab yum dang*/ kau ri singha phra man brgyad rnams dang*// che mchog la sogs khrag 'thung yab yum dang*// kau ri singha phra man brgyad rnams dang*// sgo ma bzhi dang dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad// khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ zhi ba'i lha tshogs mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar// khrag 'thung lha tshogs gar dgu'i chas kyis brgyan// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 145) 'ja' 'od thibs// bka' sdod srung mar bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ hrīḥ pad+ma 'od 'bar gnas lngar dkyil 'khor mdzes// dam pa rigs brgya rig 'dzin dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro sde lnga phur pa'i lha tshogs bcas// dkon mchog spyi 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la bstod// de nas skabs 'dir 'dzab ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs kar rang rang gi thugs srog sngags phreng dang ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su mos pa tsam dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs srog gi 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs srog la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par rtsol bar bsam zhing*/ om̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzña na dha tu āḥ

om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar gyur cig shan+ting ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes zhi ba'i 'dzab dang*/ de bzhin du rgyas pa la khro bo'i rtsa sngags de nyid kyi mjug tu/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭing ku ru ye swā hā/ dbang la/ rtsa sngags 146) kyi mthar/ khamasagasum srid gsum dbang du bsdus shig wa sham ku ru ye swā hā/ drag por/ rtsa sngags sham bur/ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭaḥ dang*/ zhes bzla zhing*/ srung rgyud las so so'i kha dog dang mthun par rdo rje'i mdud pa byas nas bsangs bran zhing me thabs kyi me lce dang du ba la bdug nas lus la gdags pa yang rung ngo*/ ༈ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la btang rag gi tshul du/ om̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod cing*/ sreg rdzas tshang mar lan re 'bul ba'am/ bsdus pa byed na dgang blugs kyi mar khu phul bas kyang 'grub ste/ rgyud sde rnams las sbyin sreg gi rdzas kyi gtso bo ni yam shing dang*/ mar khu yin par gsung pa'i phyir ro/ sngags dang dgos gsol kyang de dang mtshungs par rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas pa'i rjes la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ pad+ma 'od 'bar gnas lngar dkyil 'khor mdzes// ces sogs shwa lo ka gcig pas bstod la/ dngos grub bskul ba ni/ hrīḥ tshe dpag med mgon stong nyid 147) snying rje'i thugs// spros bral chos sku'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro don dpag med gsung*// 'gags med longs sku'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// gu ru pad+ma 'chi med rdo rje'i sku// mi 'gyur sku yi dngos grub = yi dam rta mchog dngos grub kun gyi dpal// phyag na chen po'i = rdo rje phag mo dgos 'dod re ba bskongs// mchog dang thun mongs = ye shes me lha phrin las sgrub pa'i lha// zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub =

ma dang mkha' 'gro mi zad gter gyi bdag /zas nor longs spyod = dam can rgya mtsho bstan pa bsrung ba'i bdag / rigs rgyud dbang gi dngos grub = chos skyong bsrung ma mngon spyod phrin las bsgrub// drag rtsal mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bcom ldan me 148) lha'i rgyal po yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ bdag cag yon mchod rnams la mchog thun mongs kyi dngos grub thams cad thog pa med par stsal bar mdzad du gsol/ om̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ sarba sid+dhi pha la puṣ+ṭing ku ru hoḥ zhes pas bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ tshogs la rol lo/ de nas bzod gsol nyams chags bshags te/ ho/ dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gi sku gsung thugs rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags dang cho ga lhag chad nor 'khrul la sogs pa'i nyes pa ci mgyid pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ tshe 'di'i 'gal rkyen du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ phyi ma byang chub thob pa'i bar chad du mi 'gyur bar/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ yig brgya yang brjod/ om̐/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub 149) stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams gshegs cing dam tshig pa rnams bdag bskyed kyi thugs kar thim par mos so/ ༈ de nas slar yang me cung zad kha gsos la bsangs chu 'thor zhing*/ me lha sngar ltar yid kyis gsal btab la/ btang rag gi tshul du/ om̐ ag+ni de wa t+ya/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod cing*/ bdud rtsi rak+ta gtor ma tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyang rang rang gi sngags kyi 'bul/ sreg byed gzhan rnams dang*/ drag po'i khyad par gyi rdzas liṅga la sogs kyi lhag ma thams cad kyang 'bul zhing*/ bsdu na dgang blugs kyi sbyor bas mar khu lan grangs ci rigs phul bas rung tshul ni gong bzhin no/

sreg rdzas kyi lhag rol cung zad tshogs lhag dang bcas pa las byang gi lhag ma'i tshig gis phyi rol du 'bul lo/ ༈ mthar me lha la bstod pa dang bshegs 150) gsol ni/ hūm̐/ phrin las thogs med mnga' mdzad pa'i// drang srong 'khor dang bcas la bstod// rang bzhin gnas su da gshegs la// phyogs 'dir dge zhing shis par mdzod// ag+ni de wa gats+tsha/ de nas zhi rgyas dbang gsum la ni mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma 'bul bar 'os pa rnams chad mdo byas la 'bul zhing*/ drag por ni gtor ma zor du 'phangs ba'i las rim rgyas bsdus ci rigs las gzhung ltar bya ba dang*/ gzhan yang cho ga'i mjug gi las rims bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis brjod rim du bsdu ba sogs thams cad yang zab las byang bzhin byas la yo byad rnams bsdu'o/ ༈ de ltar cho ga dngos gzhi grub nas/ zhar la rjes kyi bya ba bstan pa ni/ sbyin bsreg gi me ro ni zhi rgyas dbang gsum la long khyab yod na me ma shi bar bzhag cing*/ long med na chu gtsang dang 'o ma sogs kyi gzhel nas/ zhi ba'i me ro ni chu klung chen por dor ba dang*/ rgyas pa'i me ro ni zhing gi mu dang phyugs kyi ra ba sogs la blugs/ 151) dbang gi ni ri mtho sa nas rlung la 'phyar bar gsungs shing*/ drag po'i me ni long khyab yod kyang mi bzhag bsad la thal ba zor du 'phang ba'am/ lam mdor mnan pa sogs bya bar gsungs te/ rgyas par sbyin bsreg chen mo rnams kyi gzhung nas so so'i las kha tshar bya thabs dang bcas pa zhib par 'byung phyir de dag tu blta bar bya'o/ ༈ yang gang zhig tshe 'das kyi phung po la sbyin bsreg bya ba'i tshe na/ sdig sgrib sbyong phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kho na dgos mod kyi/ 'di la ni gang zag yul gong 'og gi khyad kyis/ bla ma skyes chen dam pa mchog rnams kyi sku gdung la ni sbyong ba dang gnas spar sogs gang yang mi dgos phyir/ pur khang du dar gyi na bza' dri bzang dang bcas pas bzhugs su gsol ste/

de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs dkyil 'khor lha dang tha mi dad par thag chod pa'i dad gus kyi sgo nas/ rang gzhan rjes 'jug mkha' khyab 'gro ba thams cad tshogs rdzas sgrib byang gi ched du sbyin 152) bsreg phul ba kho nas chog la/ ༈ yang*/ de tsam du ma yin pa'i bla ma'i tshul dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la ni/ phung po de nyid bud shing gi tshul dang rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo re shig la ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug nas de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lhar bskyed de sbyin bsreg byas pas/ sgo gsum ma dag pa'i dri ma'i dngos po thams cad dag pa chen por bsgyur ba'i thabs kyi khyad par yin pas phan yon che bar gsungs so/ ༈ gzhan gang zag tha mal pa rnams la ni/ sbyong ba dang sgrib pa bkru zhing gshaid dang 'phral thabs la sogs gang 'grub byas pa'i ro de sreg khang du bcug ste/ bdag bskyed bum bskyed la sogs grub rjes/ me sbar ba'i tshe dmigs yul de nyid kyi spyi bor nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi bag chags las grub pa'i lha'i sa bon a dkar po/ mgrin par phrag dog lha min gyi sa bon su ljang ser/ snying gar 'dod chags me'i sa bon nṛ sngo skya/ lte bar gti mug dud 'gro'i sa bon tri dmar

153) nag gsang bar ser sna yi dwags kyi sa bon pre ser skya/ rkang mthil du zhe sdang dmyal ba'i sa bon du nag po rnams gsal zhing*/ 'khor ba thogs med kyi las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad kyang yi ge de dag la 'dus par bsam/ gdos bcas kyi phung po de nyid ni bud shing gi tshul du mos la/ bdag bum gnyis ka'i thugs srog las 'od zer ye shes kyi me spungs 'bar ba 'phros pas/ kho'i las nyon bag chags ris drug gi sa bon dang bcas pa mtha' dag thul gyis bsreg par bsam la me sbar ro/ de nas sbyin bsreg tshul bzhin bya zhing 'di dag gis skabs tshor mdun bskyed kyi 'dzab kyang yig brgya 'ba' shig bzla zhing*/ sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i dus kyi 'dod gsol yang gzhan mi bya bar/ tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags 154) las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu rkyen sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sarba pā paṃ da na shan+ting ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa kho na brjod pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bor mar khu dang til nag spungs che bar 'bul lo/ lar/ tshe 'das kyi phung po sbyong ba'i tshul rnams la bka' gsar rnying tha dad kyi rgyud dang man ngag bla ma so so'i bzhed tshul sogs mi mthun pa mang phyir/ phung po lhar bskyed pa dang*/ mchod rdzas su bya ba dang*/ gzhal yas su bskyed nas rnam shes bgugs te lhar bskyed pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi bar 'khyams su bkug nas mgron thabs su byed pa dang*/ rnam shes spar nas phung po bu shing gi tshul du bya ba sogs phyag bzhes mi 'dra ba mang kyang*/ gtso bor gong du smos pa ltar gang zag mchog dman gyi khyad 'byed pa gal che bar gsungs tshe/ gang zag mchog rnams la lha dang dbyer med du mchod/ 'bring rnams la phung po gzhal yas khang bud shing gang rung la/ rnam shes lhar bskyed nas mchod/ mthar ye shes

155) gshegs pa rnam shes spar ba yin pas/ tshul 'di ni bskyed rdzogs kyi mthus pa lam byang bgrod kyi rnam par gyur te phan yon rlabs po cher 'byung bar gsungs pa dang*/ tha mal phal pa rnams la ni sdig sgrib sbyong thabs kyi sbyin bsreg kho na yin phyir/ de ltar dbye ba shes par bya'o/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ sbyin bsreg las bzhi po me thab gcig tu spyir dril bya thabs dang*/ phyogs bzhi so sor thab bzhi gang bshams nas las bzhi mthar chags su bya ba dang*/ de'i thabs chen re re la thab phran nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhis bskor nas bshams shing cho ga tshar gcig la sbyin bsreg brgya rtsa phrin las bzhi yongs rdzogs su bya ba sogs dang*/ bsnyen grub kyi sogs kyi kha bskongs sbyin bsreg brgya stong khri 'bum grangs thems su bya thabs sogs rnam grangs mang yod kyi/ 'dir ni yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi gzhung dang tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje nas gsungs pa'i sbyin bsreg myur 156) mgyogs 'od 'bar gtso bor byas zhing*/ 'khri bsnan phran bu dgos pa dag kyang dgongs 'dus dang thos grol gyi sbyin bsreg gi dgongs pa ltar bkod pa ste/ mdor na bdag 'dra rmongs pas 'di ltar 'bri bar spobs pa ma yin na'ang*/ sngon nas rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' snying po de nyid gyi zhal snga nas/ gter gsar 'di la sbyin bsreg khyer bde sgrigs chags shig cis kyang dgos par yod kyang*/ kho bo ni spyir yang rnying lugs kyi cho ga'i lag len skor 'di la ha cang gom 'gris che ba zhig med pa dang*/ khyad par na so rgas zhing blo sna thung ba'i dbang gis ma nus pas khyed kyi de lta bu zhig cis kyang bzos dang*/ rjes 'jug mang por phan pa'o zhes yang yang bka' gsal na'ang*/ rang nyid rnam g.yeng gi dbang du gyur cing*/ phyis nas ni skalapa'i 'pho 'gyur dang gang zag rnams kyi byed spyod sogs gang la bltas kyang dgos ched cig mi yong bar bsam

157) nas stsol ba ma byas te/ slad du/ rje de nyid kyi zhal slob dam par gyur pa dbon po rgyal dbang gis ched gnyer du bskul bar mdzad pa la brten nas/ shar phyogs kong rong gi yul khams mtha' dag zad pa'i dben khrod dpal ri'i gangs zhol rgod tshang phug tu/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi zin ris su bgyis pa 'di'i dge ba mtshon byed du byas nas tshe rabs kun gyi dge tshogs mtha' dag gcig tu bzlum pa'i mthus rje btsun bla ma mchog de'i dgongs pa rdzogs shing*/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dri med phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig sarba maṅgalaṃ/ dge'o/ 158)
